quotes.quote: If you can't explain it to a six year old, you don't understand it yourself.
quotes.author: Albert Einstein

quotes.quote: The art of simplicity is a puzzle of complexity.
quotes.author: Douglas Horton

quotes.quote: Simplicity is the final achievement. After one has played a vast quantity of notes and more notes, it is simplicity that emerges as the crowning reward of art.
quotes.author: Frederic Chopin

quotes.quote: Real art is basic emotion. If a scene is handled with simplicity - and I don't mean simple - it'll be good, and the public will know it.
quotes.author: John Wayne

quotes.quote: One day I will find the right words, and they will be simple.
quotes.author: Jack Kerouac,  The Dharma Bums

quotes.quote: But luxury has never appealed to me, I like simple things, books, being alone, or with somebody who understands.
quotes.author: Daphne du Maurier

quotes.quote: I wish I had invented blue jeans. They have expression, modesty, sex appeal, simplicity - all I hope for in my clothes.
quotes.author: Yves Saint Laurent

quotes.quote: Because you are beautiful. I enjoy looking at beautiful people, and I decided a while ago not to deny myself the simpler pleasures of existence
quotes.author: John Green,  The Fault in Our Stars

quotes.quote: Goodbye,"said the fox. "And now here is my secret, a very simple secret: It is only with the heart that one can see rightly; what is essential is invisible to the eye.
quotes.author: Antoine de Saint-ExupÃ©ry

quotes.quote: Dreams are always crushing when they don't come true. But it's the simple dreams that are often the most painful because they seem so personal, so reasonable, so attainable. You're always close enough to touch, but never quite close enough to hold and it's enough to break your heart.
quotes.author: Nicholas Sparks,  Three Weeks With My Brother

quotes.quote: I am beginning to learn that it is the sweet, simple things of life which are the real ones after all.
quotes.author: Laura Ingalls Wilder

quotes.quote: What I've come to learn is that the world is never saved in grand messianic gestures, but in the simple accumulation of gentle, soft, almost invisible acts of compassion.
quotes.author: Chris Abani

quotes.quote: O, to be sure, we laugh less and play less and wear uncomfortable disguises like adults, but beneath the costume is the child we always are, whose needs are simple, whose daily life is still best described by fairy tales.
quotes.author: Leo Rosten

quotes.quote: Like all magnificent things, it's very simple.
quotes.author: Natalie Babbitt,  Tuck Everlasting

quotes.quote: Life is really simple, but we insist on making it complicated.
quotes.author: Confucius

quotes.quote: Simplicity and repose are the qualities that measure the true value of any work of art.
quotes.author: Frank Lloyd Wright

quotes.quote: Simplicity is natures first step, and the last of art.
quotes.author: Philip James Bailey

quotes.quote: Any intelligent fool can make things bigger, more complex, and more violent. It takes a touch of genius -- and a lot of courage to move in the opposite direction.
quotes.author: Ernst F. Schumacher

quotes.quote: Don't get me wrong, I admire elegance and have an appreciation of the finer things in life. But to me, beauty lies in simplicity.
quotes.author: Mark Hyman

quotes.quote: Happiness. Simple as a glass of chocolate or tortuous as the heart. Bitter. Sweet. Alive.
quotes.author: Joanne Harris,  Chocolat

quotes.quote: There is no greatness where there is not simplicity, goodness, and truth.
quotes.author: Leo Tolstoy,  War and Peace

quotes.quote: The art of art, the glory of expression and the sunshine of the light of letters, is simplicity.
quotes.author: Walt Whitman

quotes.quote: I feel that the simplicity of life is just being yourself.
quotes.author: Bobby Brown

quotes.quote: The greatest ideas are the simplest.
quotes.author: William Golding,  Lord of the Flies

quotes.quote: Well, I like to eat, sleep, drink, and be in love.I like to work, read, learn, and understand life.
quotes.author: Langston Hughes

quotes.quote: It is not a daily increase, but a daily decrease. Hack away at the inessentials.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: One should use common words to say uncommon things
quotes.author: Arthur Schopenhauer

quotes.quote: The greatest step towards a life of simplicity is to learn to let go.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

quotes.quote: Possessions, outward success, publicity, luxury - to me these have always been contemptible. I believe that a simple and unassuming manner of life is best for everyone, best for both the body and the mind.
quotes.author: Albert Einstein

quotes.quote: Living simply makes loving simple.
quotes.author: bell hooks

quotes.quote: It's as simple as that. Simple and complicated, as most true things are.
quotes.author: David Levithan,  Every Day

quotes.quote: Nature is pleased with simplicity. And nature is no dummy
quotes.author: Isaac Newton

quotes.quote: Besides the noble art of getting things done, there is the noble art of leaving things undone. The wisdom of life consists in the elimination of non-essentials.
quotes.author: Lin Yutang,  The Importance of Living

quotes.quote: Truth is ever to be found in the simplicity, and not in the multiplicity and confusion of things.
quotes.author: Isaac Newton

quotes.quote: Or, rather, let us be more simple and less vain.
quotes.author: Jean-Jacques Rousseau

quotes.quote: Why did they believe? Because they saw miracles. Things one man took as chance, a man of faith took as a sign. A loved one recovering from disease, a fortunate business deal, a chance meeting with a long lost friend. It wasn't the grand doctrines or the sweeping ideals that seemed to make believers out of men. It was the simple magic in the world around them.
quotes.author: Brandon Sanderson,  The Hero of Ages

quotes.quote: A simple life is not seeing how little we can get by with--that's poverty--but how efficiently we can put first things first. . . . When you're clear about your purpose and your priorities, you can painlessly discard whatever does not support these, whether it's clutter in your cabinets or commitments on your calendar. (148)
quotes.author: Victoria Moran,  Lit From Within: Tending Your Soul For Lifelong Beauty

quotes.quote: People who pride themselves on their "complexity"and deride others for being "simplistic"should realize that the truth is often not very complicated. What gets complex is evading the truth.
quotes.author: Thomas Sowell,  Barbarians inside the Gates and Other Controversial Essays

quotes.quote: If you are out to describe the truth, leave elegance to the tailor.
quotes.author: Ludwig Boltzmann

quotes.quote: The point of simple living, for me has got to be:A soft place to landA wide margin of errorRoom to breatheLots of places to find baseline happiness in each and every day
quotes.author: Leo Babauta

quotes.quote: The philosopher Diogenes was eating bread and lentils for supper. He was seen by the philosopher Aristippus, who lived comfortably by flattering the king. Said Aristippus, 'If you would learn to be subservient to the king you would not have to live on lentils.'Said [author:Diogenes|3213618, 'Learn to live on lentils and you will not have to be subservient to the king".
quotes.author: Anthony de Mello

quotes.quote: Simplify your life. You don't grow spiritual, you shrink spiritual.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

quotes.quote: I have often said that I wish I had invented blue jeans: the most spectacular, the most practical, the most relaxed and nonchalant. They have expression, modesty, sex appeal, simplicity - all I hope for in my clothes.
quotes.author: Yves Saint Laurent

quotes.quote: Free yourself from the complexities of your life! A life of simplicity and happiness awaits you.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

quotes.quote: They think I'm simpleminded because I seem to be happy. Why shouldn't I be happy? I have everything I ever wanted and more. Maybe I am simpleminded. Maybe that's the key: simple.
quotes.author: Dolly Parton,  Dolly: My Life and Other Unfinished Business

quotes.quote: While the impostor draws his identity from past achievements and the adulation of others, the true self claims identity in its belovedness. We encounter God in the ordinariness of life: not in the search for spiritual highs and extraordinary, mystical experiences but in our simple presence in life.
quotes.author: Brennan Manning,  Abba's Child: The Cry of the Heart for Intimate Belonging

quotes.quote: There are times when wisdom cannot be found in the chambers of parliament or the halls of academia but at the unpretentious setting of the kitchen table.
quotes.author: E.A. Bucchianeri

quotes.quote: Learning isn't acquiring knowledge so much as it is trimming information that has already been acquired.
quotes.author: Criss Jami,  Killosophy

quotes.quote: Human beings, viewed as behaving systems, are quite simple. The apparent complexity of our behavior over time is largely a reflection of the complexity of the environment in which we find ourselves.
quotes.author: Herbert A. Simon,  The Sciences of the Artificial

quotes.quote: The meditative mind sees disagreeable or agreeable things with equanimity, patience, and good-will. Transcendent knowledge is seeing reality in utter simplicity. (146)
quotes.author: Jean-Yves Leloup,  Compassion and Meditation: The Spiritual Dynamic between Buddhism and Christianity

quotes.quote: Do not let your grand ambitions stand in the way of small but meaningful accomplishments.
quotes.author: Bryant McGill

quotes.quote: It takes a long time to learn how to do something simple.
quotes.author: Marty Rubin

quotes.quote: Even so, I'm somebody.I'm the Discoverer of Nature.I'm the Argonaut of true sensations.I bring a new Universe to the UniverseBecause I bring the Universe to itself.
quotes.author: Alberto Caeiro,  The Keeper of Sheep

quotes.quote: Ask a true scientist a very profound question on his science, and he will besilent. Ask a true religious person a very simple question on his religion, and he will be frenzied.
quotes.author: Kedar Joshi

quotes.quote: We're very familiar with the idea that some things are so complex they're beyond our comprehension. This not only keeps us solving and experimenting but also distracted. Many things are really so simple we can't see them under our big noses.
quotes.author: Criss Jami,  Killosophy

quotes.quote: Praise be to God I'm not good,And have the natural egotism of flowersAnd rivers following their bedPreoccupied without knowing itOnly with blooming and flowing.This is the only mission in the World,This--to exist clearly,And to know how to do it without thinking about it.)
quotes.author: Alberto Caeiro,  The Keeper of Sheep

quotes.quote: It's simple, it's not that simple; or life is simple, but the things in it are not. When a man does not understand it, he tends to inflate it. When he does, he tends to deflate it. In the end, neither images are fully accurate.
quotes.author: Criss Jami,  Killosophy

quotes.quote: The love and hope that we are born with is what keeps us relentlessly moving toward joy. We get the most happiness from the simplicity of being devoid of wants and needs.
quotes.author: Debasish Mridha

quotes.quote: A person feels the pain in judicious proportion to the sensitive nature cherished in own world; otherwise there is enough fun, happiness, enjoyment and pleasure in life.
quotes.author: Anuj Somany

quotes.quote: If you can't explain it simply, you don't understand it well enough.
quotes.author: Albert Einstein
